Add wrapped colour legend layout to a ggplot

Source: R/plots.R
add_colour_legend_layout.Rd

Applies a colour guide with a wrapped column count for top and bottom legends. Left, right, and hidden legends are returned unchanged.

Usage

add_colour_legend_layout(
  plot,
  labels,
  legend_position = "top",
  ncol = NULL,
  legend_text_size = 10,
  max_label_characters_per_row = 45,
  guide_override_aes = NULL
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot2 plot object.

labels

Character vector of legend labels.

legend_position

Legend position passed to ggplot2::theme().

ncol

Optional maximum number of legend columns.

legend_text_size

Legend text size used to scale the horizontal space estimate. Larger legend text uses fewer columns.

max_label_characters_per_row

Approximate total label characters to fit on one horizontal legend row.

Value

A ggplot2 plot object with colour legend layout applied when needed.
